_comment: EP48.5 O1 - ingress for the DEDICATED Cloudflare tunnel 'pdabliss-core' (remotely managed). PREPARED ONLY: nothing is created at O1.
Applied at O5 (tunnel, no public hostname) / O6 (public hostname + DNS) only, after separate owner approval.
The 'config' object is the body of the Cloudflare API call 'PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations'
(or the same rules entered in the dashboard: Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels > pdabliss-core > Public hostnames, in this order).
The existing tunnels (Cloudflared, CloudflaredS2A / 's2aconsultant-server') are NOT touched.
Rules are evaluated top to bottom; 'path' is a regular expression matched against the decoded request path.
Contracts verified in cb21be1: the API lives under /api/v1 (backend/src/app.ts prefix '/api/v1'); /health and /health/ready
are backend routes (backend/src/routes/health.ts); sign-up is POST /api/v1/auth/register and POST /api/v1/auth/verification/resend;

fallbackIfHttpStatusUnavailable._comment: If the dashboard cannot set http_status:404 for a public-hostname path, the two sign-up rules become ONE hostname-scoped WAF custom rule (block), with owner approval (OD-P3). No zone-wide rule.
fallbackIfHttpStatusUnavailable.expression: (http.host eq "core.pdabliss.com" and (http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/v1/auth/(register|verification/resend)/?$" or http.request.uri.path matches "^/((en|zh)/)?register/?$"))
